mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages_raw (message_key, device_id, imei, message_code, process_dttm, latitude, longitude, raw_payload, error_yn, error_detail, received_at) VALUES (#{messageKey}, #{deviceId}, #{imei}, #{messageCode}, #{processDttm}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{rawPayload}, #{errorYn}, #{errorDetail}, #{receivedAt}) ON CONFLICT (message_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING message_id
mapper.update: UPDATE messages_raw SET error_yn = 'Y', error_detail = #{errorDetail} WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
UPDATE messages_raw SET device_id = #{deviceId}, error_yn = 'N', error_detail = NULL WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
UPDATE messages_raw SET error_yn = 'N', error_detail = NULL WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*)::int AS c FROM messages_raw WHERE error_yn = 'Y'
SELECT message_id FROM messages_raw WHERE message_key = #{messageKey}
